revised_document:
Without prejudice — LEX_001

We propose settlement for INR 2,500,000 without a confidentiality provision, subject to our client’s approval and a signed agreement. We understand that you have not accepted these terms and have indicated that your client would consider at least INR 4,000,000 with confidentiality. Please let us know whether your client would reconsider our proposal.

Both sides should accurately report the proposed amount and confidentiality terms to their respective clients. No settlement has been reached.
